title: skels sabers cit
description: adds ot and prequal sabers with a bit of clone wars rebels and customs mixed in
body:
lightsabers!!! everyone loves them, but they arent in minecraft normally and if you want them on servers its extra hard? the solution... CIT. with the unoffical but greatly appreciated cit continuation added you can finnally get your custom items via anivil and renaming!!! 



as for what this pack adds, anything in () is just a note use the non () or * text in an anvil *use these names to get the saber simply rename a sword or spear just not gold stone or wood*:prequal sabers: obiwans saber, anakins saber (can be used as lukes ot saber obvously), plos saber (plo koon), mace windus saber, quaigons saber, yodas saber, palpatines saber, count dookus saber. orginal trilogy: lukes saber (rotj), vaders saber. clone wars: ahsokas I saber and ahsokas II saber (come as a pair), venterss saber (can be used in pairs of two), dark saber. Rebels:kanans saber, ezras saber, mk2 E saber (season 3-4 ezra saber). customs:blue colored:jedi knights saber, green colored:masters saber,purple colored:inbetweeners saber,yellow colored:bendu imprints saber, orange colored:traitors saber, red:sith saber.

but thats not all, I intend to make a 2.0 that adds things like kylo wrens saber and more of the jedi consule, dlc for double blades like maul, the inquisitors, and temple guards, and a legends dlc that adds old republic and other famous sabers like star killers or mara jades. there might also be a fallen order dlc as cals saber has so many customizations but idk that might get messy might just add him to double blade. oh and maybe eventually maybe custom armor and other weapons.
